text: Tool-call and token counts now always hold their space and only become visible on hover, so rows no longer re-wrap titles. A before/after measurement showed the row size unchanged. With "Hide the rest" on, each run of parts without matches folds in the graph into one dashed grey "⋯ N without matches" box. With the Errors filter on the first phase, the graph drops from 25 boxes to 17. Limitations: folded boxes can't be clicked open, and the "22 turns" count still reflects the unfolded graph. A new unit test covers folding; all 63 tests pass. Committed as e86630d, not pushed.
